en: AZ
text: AZ

en: Hm? A young Trainer, out on the old landing. Not many walk this far.
text: Hm? Un tânăr Antrenor, pe vechiul debarcader. Nu mulți ajung atât de departe.

en: I am called AZ. I was a king, once. A very long time ago.
text: Mă numesc AZ. Am fost rege, odinioară. Cu foarte mult timp în urmă.

en: My land was at war, and I could not stop it. So I built a machine that could. A weapon, the greatest ever made.
text: Țara mea era în război și nu l-am putut opri. Așa că am construit o mașinărie care putea. O armă, cea mai mare făcută vreodată.

en: It ended the war. It also took the life of a small Floette who had been my dearest friend.
text: A pus capăt războiului. A luat și viața unui Floette mic care îmi fusese cel mai drag prieten.

en: I could not bear it. I gave my own life to the machine to find her. I have waited here, in one form or another, ever since.
text: N-am putut îndura. Mi-am dat propria viață mașinăriei ca s-o găsesc. Am așteptat aici, într-o formă sau alta, de atunci.

en: They tell me you have walked all of Kalos and stood in the Hall of Fame. You have shown that Pokémon and people can be strong together.
text: Mi se spune că ai străbătut tot Kalos și ai stat în Sala Faimei. Ai arătat că Pokémonii și oamenii pot fi puternici împreună.

en: I would like to see it for myself. Not a weapon. A bond. Show me!
text: Aș vrea să văd și eu asta. Nu o armă. O legătură. Arată-mi!

en: Ah... yes. That is what I forgot. Power is not what the war was missing. It was this.
text: Ah... da. Asta am uitat. Puterea nu era ce lipsea războiului. Asta lipsea.

en: Thank you, {player}. Perhaps the long wait has been worth it. Take these, with an old man's thanks.
text: Mulțumesc, {player}. Poate așteptarea lungă a meritat. Ia-le, cu mulțumirile unui bătrân.

en: Some days I sit here and listen to the sea. It does not ask for anything. I am learning from it.
text: Unele zile stau aici și ascult marea. Nu cere nimic. Învăț de la ea.

en: {rival}
text: {rival}

en: {player}! I came out on the first train. Kiloude's the end of the line, so I knew you'd turn up here sooner or later.
text: {player}! Am venit cu primul tren. Kiloude e capătul liniei, așa că am știut că vei apărea aici mai devreme sau mai târziu.

en: Champion, huh? I'm not jealous. Much. But I haven't stopped chasing you. Battle me!
text: Campion, hm? Nu-s gelos. Prea tare. Dar nu am încetat să te urmăresc. Luptă cu mine!

en: {rival}
text: {rival}

en: Still the Champion. All right. I'll keep training up here, where the wind off the sea is strong.
text: Tot Campionul. Bine. Voi continua să mă antrenez aici, unde vântul de pe mare e puternic.

en: Take this. I found it on the beach, of all places. It's a Mega Stone, for an Absol. It'll do more good with you.
text: Ia asta. Am găsit-o pe plajă, dintre toate locurile. E o Piatră Mega, pentru un Absol. Va face mai mult bine la tine.

en: Oh, and the professor rang. He wants to meet you by the sundial in Anistar City. Something about your Key Stone.
text: A, și profesorul a sunat. Vrea să te întâlnească la cadranul solar din Anistar City. Ceva despre Piatra-Cheie.

en: I won? I won! Come back when you're ready. I'm not going anywhere.
text: Am câștigat? Am câștigat! Revino când ești gata. Eu nu plec nicăieri.

en: Another battle? I train up here every day.
text: Altă luptă? Mă antrenez aici în fiecare zi.

en: {rival}
text: {rival}

en: Same time tomorrow?
text: La aceeași oră mâine?

en: Whenever you like. The sea's not going anywhere, and neither am I.
text: Oricând vrei. Marea nu pleacă nicăieri, nici eu.

en: That's enough for one day. Come back tomorrow, and I'll be stronger!
text: Destul pentru o zi. Revino mâine, iar eu voi fi mai puternic!

en: I carry the bags off the train from Lumiose. Big ones, small ones, ones that bark.
A regular? There's one lady. Every night, the last train in, with a long flat parcel she won't let me carry.
And every morning, the first train back to Lumiose, with the same parcel. Here's one of her old tickets.
{player} noted the ticket for the last train in and the first out.
Last train in, first train out, and a parcel as long as a door. She never misses.
The lady with the parcel comes by day now, and she lets me carry her easel. Progress!
Kiloude's light is the best in Kalos. I paint the sea every morning, and every morning it's different.
Odd things at night? The house by the shore smells of fresh varnish every morning. Somebody paints there till dawn.
Students, I think. I heard a teacher saying, look at the brushstrokes, see how the master did it.
{player} noted the smell of fresh varnish at night.
Fresh varnish every morning. Whoever they are, they work hard.
There's a painting class in town now, by day. I've joined it! Never too old to learn.
Odile
So Looker has found me out. Yes, I take the painting out of its frame each night. I bring it here, and I bring it back.
My students can't learn from a postcard. They must see the real brushstrokes! Still, if you insist, we shall duel.
...A masterful stroke. Very well. I'll ask the museum properly. Tell Looker I'll call at his agency.
